channel.title: CONFIGURE DATA INGESTION FOR FORTISOAR & FORTIANALYZER :: Can't Code? No Problem
channel.description: There are multiple ways to integrate with FortiSOAR. In this section we will focus on having FortiSOAR pull from FortiAnalyzer. The FortiAnalyzer Events, created by FortiAnalyzer Event Handlers, will be created as FortiSOAR Alerts via the Data Ingestion process. Objectives Configure External System Data Ingestion Capabilities Work with Data Ingestion Components Time to Complete Estimated: 30 Minutes

item.title: Authorize the FortiGate on FortiAnalyzer
item.description: In this section we prep the FortiAnalyzer to receive logs from the Enterprise Core FortiGate Access the FortiAnalyzer by clicking on the Enterprise FortiAnalyzer HTTPS button from your demo instance or by browsing to https://<your instance>.fortidemo.fortinet.com:14003/ Sign in with fortinet/$3curityFabric Go to Device Manager> Unauthorized Devices Select the Enterprise_Core FortiGate by checking the box or right clicking, and click the Authorize Button Click the OK button on the popup to confirm the authorization.

item.title: TRIGGER SOME LOGS FROM THE FGT
item.description: Access the FortiGate by clicking on the Enterprise_Core HTTPS button from your demo instance or by browsing to https://<your instance>.fortidemo.fortinet.com:14002/ Sign in with fortinet/$3curityFabric Access the integrated ssh via the button at the top right. Run the command “diagnose log test” in the CLI console. This will kick off some test events from the FG and will show up. Run the command about 3x in a row to generate more logs.

item.title: CONFIRM FORTIANALYZER HAS EVENTS
item.description: We want to make sure that the FAZ has some events. These are events that we want to be handled via FortiSOAR to turn into to You should see new events last updated “A few seconds ago”. Access the FortiAnalyzer by clicking on the Enterprise FortiAnalyzer HTTPS button from your demo instance or by browsing to https://<your instance>.fortidemo.fortinet.com:14003/ . Sign in with fortinet/$3curityFabric Go to Incidents & Events > Events Monitor Confirm you see botnet events created with Medium or High Severity Note Events may take a few minutes to appear.

item.title: CONFIGURE FORTISOAR FOR DATA INGESTION
item.description: In this section we will configure FortiSOAR to retrieve FortiAnalyzer events. Go to the Data Ingestion module inside the Automation group. Look for the FortiAnalyzer Connector. This was setup by default in the lab but comes from configuring the FortiAnalyzer Connector Config. Click the 1 Configuration Available dropdown.

item.title: CONFIRM ALERTS ARE CREATED FROM FORTIANALYZER EVENTS
item.description: Now that we have Alerts in FortiSOAR we could start working these using our standard operation flow. Bonus Points 💸 Assign 2-3 of these alerts to SocUser2 by clicking the check box on those alerts, and then Reassign to SocUser2. Login to that users email on FortiMail and confirm the alert notifications were sent to the user. Meet the SLA by closing those alerts as false positives.
